name: Magical Arm Shield
extDescription: You can only activate this card when your opponent declares an attack. Take control of 1 of your opponent''s face-up monsters, except the attacking monster, and this monster is attacked instead. At the end of the Battle Phase, return control of this monster to your opponent.

name: Harpie's Feather Duster
extDescription: Destroy all of your opponent''s Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Slate Warrior
extDescription: FLIP: Increase the ATK and DEF of this card by 500 points. The ATK and DEF of a monster that destroys this card as a result of battle is decreased by 500 points.

name: Dunames Dark Witch
extDescription: Even when all odds are against this brave fairy, she will press onwards in battle and never retreat.

name: Garma Sword
extDescription: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, Garma Sword Oath.

name: Zaborg the Thunder Monarch
extDescription: When this card is Tribute Summoned, destroy 1 monster on the field.

name: Granmarg the Rock Monarch
extDescription: When this card is Tribute Summoned, destroy 1 face-down card on the field.

name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
extDescription: When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can destroy up to 2 Spell or Trap Cards on the field.

name: Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch
extDescription: When this card is Tribute Summoned, discard 1 random card from your opponent''s hand to the Graveyard. If the discarded card was a Monster Card, inflict damage to your opponent''s Life Points equal to the Level of the monster x 100 points.

name: Garma Sword Oath
extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon Garma Sword. You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 7 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Berserk Gorilla
extDescription: If this card is in face-up Defense Position on the field, destroy this card. The controller of this card must attack with this card if possible.

name: Ultimate Offering
extDescription: By paying 500 Life Points, Normal Summon or Set 1 extra monster. You can only activate this effect during your Main Phase or your opponent''s Battle Phase.

name: Gatekeeper
extDescription: An indestructible mechanoid created for the sole purpose of guarding the gateways.

name: Behegon
extDescription: With an enormous maw and massive teeth, this monstrosity is one dangerous and strange serpent from the deep.

name: Violent Rain
extDescription: This monster can call forth sudden torrents of battering rain.

name: Temple of Skulls
extDescription: A mysterious temple of skulls and bones that pulls in unsuspecting enemies.

name: Blocker
extDescription: Constructed from several components, this monster can launch them in a pincer attack.

name: Wretched Ghost of the Attic
extDescription: A harmless monster found lurking in just about any attic.

name: Sectarian of Secrets
extDescription: This wizard worships the darkness, and is served by a sinister hand that drags its enemies into oblivion.

name: Necrolancer the Timelord
extDescription: The one-eyed Necrolancer launches his onslaught from a dimensional ring that can appear out of thin air.
